title: Heavenly Tree
body:

Description

The heavenly tree is a large pale yellow tree that has light rays emanating from its leaves and emits a bright yellow glow.

This tree only spawns for a period of 24 hours[1], starting the morning of Saturday[2] (12:00 AM, EST). This tree can spawn anywhere on the map, Although, it tends to spawn in more barren environments (Including underwater). However, any trees spawned before this time will remain until they’re either harvested or die. It is highly recommended to get a UFO and fly to the Heavenly Shrine at Snowy peaks. Alternatively a Freecam can be used. If one of the pedestals light up, that means a Heavenly Tree is in that direction.

(IMPORTANT): In order to harvest the tree, it requires you to use at minimum a Refined Axe.

Tip

Heavenly Trees can sometimes spawn in awkward hard to reach places. Due to this it is recommended that you use a helicopter and its winch, added on update v.112.0 - April 11th 2026, to transport said trees easily.

Trivia

Originally this tree was going to spawn on Fridays, but a poll made on 10/3/2025 changed that, it now spawns on ONLY Saturdays[3]
